_comment: Frozen SK detector description for the WAND production. Pinned so edits to SK_physics_config.json cannot silently change the campaign; fspec is written out explicitly rather than inherited from detector_params._ANGULAR_REFL_DEFAULTS. Reflection rates were the placeholder 0.2/0.2 for campaigns up to 2026-09-28, then raised deliberately to the measured values below, in step with SK_physics_config.json. Every WAND output is being regenerated for the first-hit deposit and leg bound, so this costs no extra generation. Datasets written before 2026-09-28 (WAND/{SK,HK,SK_WAND,SK_hktwin}) used 0.2/0.2 and are a DIFFERENT generation, not extra statistics for this one.
_comment_reflection: wall: SK black PET liner, R~0.05, ~55% specular [Abe et al., NIM A737 (2014) 253]. sensor: PMT glass + bialkali photocathode from water, R~0.25, ~90% specular [Motta & Schonert, NIM A539 (2005) 217].

trigger._note: SK trigger: HK's n_thr=45 scaled by the PMT ratio (11096/19746=0.562). Validated 2026-07-23 with lucid.production.trigger_study on WAND/SK/GeV config_06: 300 events, physics efficiency 100.0% on every event, 1-5 gates/event. NOT revalidated against the 2026-09-28 reflection change, which lowers wall reflectivity 0.2 -> 0.05 and so reduces late light: recheck efficiency before trusting the gate count.
